meeting_point: Pickup in Boston at your location
description:
Start your adventure with private pick-up in Boston, then travel north to historic Salem, a city forever marked by the infamous witch trials of 1692. Walk the streets where hysteria once ruled, and learn about the Puritan past that shaped daily life in early New England. Uncover the tragic history of the witch trials during a visit to the moving Witch Trials Memorial.

Discover Salem’s prosperity during the “Old China Trade,” when Salem’s tall ships sailed to far-off ports in China and India. These voyages brought back exotic goods like tea, porcelain, and silk, making Salem one of the wealthiest towns in the young United States. This era produced America’s first millionaire, Elias Hasket Derby, whose fortune and influence left a lasting mark on the city. Step into this world at the Salem Maritime National Historic Site, and see how trade helped shape Salem’s identity beyond the witch trials.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of free time to have lunch at your choice of local restaurants and browse the many shops for souvenirs. Salem is full of treasures for every taste—you can find everything from classic magnets and T-shirts to love spells, tarot decks, and potion ingredients. Afterward, continue exploring Salem’s historic landmarks and cultural treasures before your private ride returns you to your door at the end of the day.

what_is_included_items.value: Private vehicle for groups of 9 or less

itinerary:
1. 50 min - Pick Up and Transfer to Salem
Your guide will pick you up in a comfortable minivan and drive you out to Salem!

2. 15 min - East India Square
Get situated, use the restroom, and get your first glimpse of Salem!

3. 25 min - Salem Common
At the Salem Common, stop by the Roger Conant Statue. Across the street, view the Salem Witch Museum as the Salem Witch Trials are introduced.

4. 40 min - Witch Trials Memorial
Hear the true story of the Salem Witch Trials. Learn about who the victims were, why and how they ended up there, and more.

5. 20 min - Old Burying Point
See the oldest cemetery in Salem, where some of its earliest settlers are buried.

6. 10 min - Peabody House
See this historic Colonial Revival, built in the 1800s by one of Salem's merchants.

7. 15 min -Houdini Way
Learn about Harry Houdini's famous escape from the town jail.

8. 20 min - Bewitched Statue
Learn how a fire at the studio helped put Salem on the map!

9. 90 min - Break
Break for lunch and souvenir shopping.

10. 30 min - The Witch House
Go inside the Witch House, built in 1642. Judge Corwin of the Witch Trials once lived in this very home. Learn all about the Corwin Curse!

11. 15 min - Ropes Mansion
See the historic, 1700s-era mansion used in the filming of Hocus Pocus. Learn about the famous ghosts who haunt the building.

12. 20 min - Hamilton Hall
Stop by "America's First Red Carpet," at this dance hall named for the founding father.

13. 20 min - Chestnut Street
Walk one of Salem's most prestigious and historic streets. Learn stories of the wealthy mansions lining the street, built from the prosperous "Old China" trade.

14. 20 min - The Merchant
See the most haunted building in Salem, standing on the original foundation from when the infamous George Corwin owned the property.

15. 20 min - Derby Wharf
Drive by Salem's harbor while looking at the historic Derby Wharf. Learn how Salem became the richest town in the country through trade.

16. 10 min - Proctor's Ledge
See where the hangings during the Witch Trials actually took place.

17. 1 hour - Return to Boston
Ride in comfort back to Boston and get dropped off at your hotel!
